scope: Initial/refresh tile seeding only. QP wire/timing, pre-QP density-target assignment, post-QP tile assignment and final lane legalization retain their existing algorithms.
initial_score: net_weight * (incoming_local_HPWL + outgoing_local_HPWL) + density_weight * marginal_tile_overload; no candidate timing, criticality, switching or coordinate-displacement score
x_policy: New/invalid crossing: nearest source-side entry X with free capacity; expand only when a nearer column has no capacity. Retained crossing: preserve its already optimized column.
y_policy: Among minimum-score candidates select smallest prospective utilization (N+1)/C, then old tile if still tied, otherwise nearest to midpoint of remaining tied legal entry Y values; lower Y and physical identity break residual ties.
initialization_complexity: Cache endpoint boxes once per crossing. Search nearest feasible X column, then refine Y in selected column with complete adjacent local trees. Up to 60 row scores per pass in a normal U250 column, instead of full 16-column timing scans.

density_parameters.weight_units: equivalent AMF layout-length per occupancy penalty
density_parameters.note: Inherited heuristic value, not newly calibrated; initial capacity is exact tile supply even when post-QP density bins use a coarser experimental row height.

unchanged.topology_split: Existing optional spatial/critical receiver-group proposals and full-cost topology comparison remain unchanged. They are separate from the simplified candidate-position scorer and may still evaluate timing.

limits: Fixed-topology position seeding is timing-independent; optional topology selection can still change receiver groups based on timing.
No whole-design or routed QoR claim.
This scope does not remove the cost of later density-target and post-QP full-cost searches.
